description: NOAA USA Storm Events Database 1950-2025 is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by ArcGIS Living Atlas Team. When severe weather occurs in the United States, there are networks of humans and sensors that observe and report the events and their details to the National Weather Service. These storm reports are aggregated and archived by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of ArcGIS Living Atlas Team. Its keywords are weather, severe weather, storm, thunderstorm, wind, hail, disaster, tornado. The bounding box given is -171.4000,-14.4000,171.4689,70.5029. The hub shows 2026-06-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
